text: The Director, Service System Planning and Integrity, Toronto Shelter and Support Services; the Director, Housing Policy and Strategy, Housing Secretariat; and the Director, Housing Stability Services, Housing Secretariat, will give an overview of housing, homeless, and shelter services for the Francophone communities.

The Toronto Francophone Affairs Advisory Committee recommends that: 1. The Economic and Community Development Committee request the General Manager, Toronto Shelter and Support Services and the Executive Director, Housing Secretariat, to promote French language housing and shelter services and make information about these services more readily available to the public through City communications channels, including the City of Toronto website, social media, and information for Francophone community organizations.
